steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Health: is a state of physical and mental wellbeing, not just the absence of disease. Diseases can be communicable (can be passed between individuals) or non-communicable (cannot be passed on). Risk factors increase the likelihood of developing a non-communicable disease.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Define the term "health." (1 mark) | Explain the difference between a communicable disease and a non-communicable disease. Give one example of each. (3 marks) | Explain the difference between a benign tumour and a malignant tumour. (3 marks)
